svg.text: Three different words for three different people. Examiners test whether you can tell them apart.
for the person who IS ill

g.text: Separates a confirmed or suspected case
Lasts while the person is infectious
Purpose: stop this patient infecting others

svg.text: for the person who is WELL but exposed

g.text: Restricts a well contact who may be incubating
Lasts one full incubation period from
Purpose: catch them before they spread it

svg.text: CONTACT TRACING — THE WORK THAT CONNECTS THE TWO

g.text: List everyone exposed during the infectious period, working outward from the case
Find them, explain without blaming, and check whether they have symptoms
Watch them for one incubation period; test, treat or vaccinate where that is offered
Any contact who develops symptoms becomes a case — and the tracing starts again from them

svg.text: Confidentiality is what makes it work. A community that fears exposure will hide its cases.
